Custom CSS classes applied to the outer container
that wraps the entire radio group.

props.description:
The currently selected value.

props.description:

props.description:
Top label displayed above the slider.
Useful for identifying the field in forms.

props.name: labelHint
props.description:
Optional hint displayed to the right of the label.
Often used for contextual help or inline descriptions.

props.name: labelClass
props.description: Custom Tailwind classes applied to the label element.

props.name: containerClass
props.description:
Custom Tailwind classes applied to the outer container
that wraps the entire slider component.

props.description: Custom Tailwind classes applied to the slider thumbs.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum allowed numeric value of the slider.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum allowed numeric value of the slider.

props.name: valueMin
props.description:
The current selected minimum value (left thumb).
This makes the component fully controlled.

props.name: valueMax
props.description:
The current selected maximum value (right thumb).
This makes the component fully controlled.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Callback triggered whenever either thumb moves.
Receives the updated min and max values.

props.name: valueSuffix
props.description:
Optional string appended to displayed values.
Example: "kg", "₹", "cm", "hrs", "%".

props.name: error
props.description:
Error message to display below the slider.
If provided, the slider is styled with an error state.

props.name: showErrorMessage
props.description:
Whether the error message should be shown.
Defaults to true.

props.name: options
props.description: List of options to display in the dropdown

props.name: selected
props.description:
Currently selected option(s).
- For single select: a single T or null
- For multi-select: T[]

props.name: labelKey
props.description: Name of the field inside option objects to use as the label (defaults to "label")

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Name of the field inside option objects to use as the value (defaults to "value")

props.description: Input ID attribute; defaults to the name field

props.description: Input name attribute

props.description: Text label displayed above the component

props.description: Optional hint element (string or JSX) displayed beside the label

props.description:
Callback fired when selection changes.
- Single select → value is T or null

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the entire SelectBox is disabled

props.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer container

props.description: Placeholder text displayed when no value is selected

props.description: Maximum number of selections allowed in multi-select mode

props.description: Whether to show an error message below the field

props.name: error
props.description: Error message displayed below the component

props.description:
Enables async search mode:
- Component will not filter options locally
- Calls onSearch(query) when user types

props.description:
Async search callback.
Should update the `options` prop externally after fetching.

props.name: searchable

props.name: required
props.description: Mark input as required (used for accessibility)

props.name: allowAdd
props.description: Whether to show an “Add new” option when no results match

props.name: addNewText
props.description: Label prefix for the “Add new” action (e.g., "Create")

props.name: onAdd
props.type: ((value: string) => string | void | T | Promise<string | void | T>)
props.description:
Callback when the user chooses the "create/add" option.

It may:
 - return void (do nothing automatically)
 - return a string or BaseOption → the component will auto-add/select it
 - return a Promise resolving to the above

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show a clear (X) button for single-select mode

props.description: Table layout mode ("auto" or "fixed"). Default = "auto"

props.description: Table content (Head + Body + Foot)

props.name: tabs
props.description: Tabs data (label + panel). Order defines visual order.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Variant for the tab list's appearance.
Only supported values: "underline" | "segmented" | "solid"

- "underline" (default): modern underline indicator under active tab
- "segmented": segmented pill style where selected tab looks like a pill
- "solid": solid nav tabs (selected tab has solid background)

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Starting tab index (controlled by TabGroup defaultIndex)

props.description: Extra classes for the outer group container

props.description: Extra classes to apply to the TabList wrapper

props.name: panelClass
props.description: Extra classes to apply to individual TabPanel wrapper

props.description: Render extra-small sized text (`text-xs/5`).

props.name: small
props.description: Render small sized text (`text-sm/6`).

props.name: strong
props.description: Render bold/semibold text (`font-semibold`).

props.name: muted
props.description: Apply muted gray tone (commonly used for secondary text).

props.name: error
props.description: Apply error color styling (`text-red-500`).

props.name: id
props.description:
Unique identifier of the toast instance.
Generated internally by ToastProvider.

props.name: message
props.description: The message text displayed inside the toast.

props.name: type
props.description:
Visual style of the toast based on its purpose.
- `success` — positive confirmations
- `error` — failures or critical issues
- `info` — general helpful information
- `warning` — caution or attention required

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Triggers removal of the toast.
Managed internally by the ToastProvider.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional additional class names to customize the toast container.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each row in pixels (required for virtualization)

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height (px) the table body can take. AutoSizer will size to available space.
